title: ui-preview: create summary display
description: Create a summary display component that presents extracted artifacts in a structured, reviewable format. Shows key information about discovered artifacts including names, types, relationships, and quality metrics to help users understand what was extracted before proceeding.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL display a comprehensive summary of extracted artifacts
THE SYSTEM SHALL organize artifacts by type and relevance

event_driven.trigger: WHEN artifacts are loaded into preview
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL render the summary with artifact details grouped by category

event_driven.trigger: WHEN user expands an artifact category
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL show detailed information for artifacts in that category

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT display misleading or truncated information
unwanted.because: Users need accurate information to make decisions

unwanted.condition: IF summary exceeds reasonable display length
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT render an unscrollable wall of text

preconditions: Artifacts array must be populated with valid data
Artifact types must be defined and categorizable
Display container must have sufficient space
postconditions: All artifacts are displayed in organized categories
Users can expand/collapse categories for detail
Summary accurately reflects extracted artifact data
invariants: Display order is deterministic and reproducible

happy: Given 10 artifacts are extracted, when summary displays, then all 10 artifacts are shown grouped by type
Given artifacts with different types, when summary renders, then each type has its own expandable section
Given user clicks expand on functions category, when expanded, then all function artifacts are visible with details
error: Given empty artifacts array, when summary renders, then empty state message is displayed
Given artifact with missing required fields, when summary renders, then placeholder text is shown for missing fields
Given extremely large artifact dataset, when summary renders, then pagination or virtualization is applied
